format.file: {format, spec, cases: [case]}; every case runs on its own, from an empty engine, with risk inert (ignore_risk).
format.tokens: the mints table as c1b's, plus complete_slot (the token's historical completion, null: none) and pool (its PumpSwap pool, null: none), which the engine's graduation reads (engine.py:977-992).
format.cost_scenario: the journal's state 'cost_scenario' as paper.engine main writes it (json.dumps(asdict(scn), sort_keys=True), engine.py:1494): the base scenario of week2-defaults.yaml. Parse it with float_roundtrip.
format.expect_ops: every journal write of the five tables in the engine's order: ["put", table, row] with the table's columns (journal.py TABLES; null where the engine writes none) or ["delete", "positions", key]. The final positions table is empty.
format.integers: every integer fits i64; ret is a float, parse it with float_roundtrip.
format.case: name, why, clock, dev_bounds, groups, labels, tokens, pools, events (as in c2_position_cases.json FORMAT), learn, cost_scenario, expect_ops, expect_flag_fix_days. tokens and pools are the snapshot: what the feed knows at the start.
format.arrival: M3-11: an event may carry arrival [received_unix_ns, created_unix_ns, written_unix] (each nullable), as LiveFeed's Event.arrival: the signal rows of its slot read it for the latency columns (engine.py _latency).
format.expect_flag_fix_days: M3-11: the engine's flag_fix_days after the run (state farm_flag_fixes): {day: [fixes, of them in a pool with an open position]}.
format.learn: what the feed learns while it reads, in order: {at_slot, token} (a tokens row: the token is replaced), {at_slot, pool} (a pools row: added when the pool is not known yet, as a SOL market when its quote_class is sol or reversed), {at_slot, history: {pool, events}} (M3-08b: a backfill's trades of the pool, history only, drained at the next slot end as LiveFeed's drain_history) or {at_slot, epoch, ms} (the epoch's ms per slot in the engine's clock), or {at_slot, flag_fix: {pool, order, farmer}} (M3-11: a recorded trade's farmer flag computed again, order its [slot, tx, outer, inner], drained at the next slot end after the backfills as LiveFeed's drain_flag_fixes), or {at_slot, forget_token: mint} (M3-11 v0.3: the token leaves the feed's tokens, as LiveFeed's _prune drops it), or {at_slot, late_probe: pool} (creation-filters spec v0.2 §4 option A: the pool's probe backfill reached past the replay window, LiveFeed's late_probe_pools; its farm window counts 0 until it was seen for 24 h unless it has a backfill). An item applies right before the first event whose slot is >= at_slot, after the last event when there is none (lab/core: learn_token, learn_pool, add_history, fix_farm, forget_token, mark_late_probe, set_epoch_ms before that push).
format.window_rule: the feed's farm-window rule: all_pools (a replay's, CaseFeed) or live (M3-08b: LiveFeed's per pool, engine.py:806-813; lab/core WindowRule::Live).

P4 is learned with the event after that (O at t + 302), past the end of its trigger slot t + 300: no row for it. cases.name: backfill_as_history
cases.why: Live rule. PD is recorded from t - 30 (its trigger's inflow) and triggers at t. With that first recorded trade comes a backfill of PD's earlier trades: t - 3,000 (a farmer's 60 SOL buy, within the hour) and t - 20,000, plus the recorded inflow again (an overlap, counted once). PD's rows: farm_window_complete 1 (backfilled), pool_seen_slot t - 20,000, farm 'flagged' (the farmer's volume is over half the hour's): H (organic) skips 'farm flagged', K3 enters.

cases.name: backfill_of_an_unknown_pool
cases.why: Live rule. PU is not in the snapshot. A backfill of its earlier trades (t - 3,000: a farmer's 60 SOL buy) comes with O's event at t - 2,000 and is drained at that slot's end (O's next event, t - 1,000), before the feed knows PU; PU is learned with its trigger's inflow (t - 30). Its rows: farm_window_complete 1 (backfilled), pool_seen_slot t - 3,000, but farm 'organic': the farmer's trade never reached a farm window, so H enters. (Learned with the event at t - 1,000 instead, PU would be known at that drain: LiveFeed's learns come before the end of the slot before.)
